## `artifact`

### English

```text
Wrap a completed payload in a run-bound candidate, or check it before registration.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit artifact init --run <run.json> --type <type> --payload <payload.json> [--input <registered-ART-id>] [--artifact-id <ART-id>] --output <artifacts/new-candidate.json>
  accessibility-audit artifact validate --run <run.json> --artifact <artifacts/candidate.json>

Notes:
  - Types: screening-observations, human-review-queue, declared-human-review, remediation-plan, audit-context, participant-usability-observation, declared-change-record. --input is repeatable.
  - For audit-context, also provide --role <declared_context_reviewer|declared_context_owner> --evidence-file <saved-file> --target-ref <declared-target> --captured-at <RFC3339>. See references/audit-context.md.
  - For participant-usability-observation, use --role declared_participant_facilitator with the same saved-evidence options. See references/participant-usability-observation.md.
  - For declared-change-record, use --input <remediation-plan-id>, --role declared_change_reviewer|declared_change_owner, --after-inventory <captured.json>, and the same saved-evidence options. See references/declared-change-record.md.
  - The CLI fills envelope metadata and omitted payload schema_version. Supply actual observations, review declarations or proposals in --payload; none are invented.
  - Human review payloads must be the reviewer's actual declaration; AI agents must not write human outcomes or evidence on their behalf. Metadata does not authenticate identity.
  - Creates a private candidate only; register performs live target checks. Prefer review-queue and human-review export/import for guided authoring. See references/agent-orchestration.md.
```

```text
注意:

  - For participant-usability-observation, use --role declared_participant_facilitator with the same saved-evidence options. See references/participant-usability-observation.md.
```

## `review-queue`

### English

```text
Create a target-bound human review candidate from registered observations and explicit requirements.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit review-queue --run <run.json> --artifact-id <ART-id> --output <artifacts/new-queue.json> [--scope screening|profile_all] [--requirement <profile-requirement-id>]

Notes:
  - --requirement is repeatable. Priorities start unprioritized; review reasons, target locations and required state before registration.
  - Creates a private candidate only. It does not perform human review, register evidence, or change the audit run. See references/human-review-queue.md.
```


## `audit-bundle`

### English

```text
Prepare or verify offline commitments to audit files and a signed predecessor chain.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit audit-bundle prepare --root <directory> --run <run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --report <report.md|html> --output <new-private-record.json>
  accessibility-audit audit-bundle verify --root <directory> --record <private-record.json> [trust options]

Options:
  --report <file>                          Prepare: 1–16 explicit reports; repeat for multiple formats.
  --attachment <file>                      Prepare: explicitly retained source/capture file; repeatable.
  --predecessor <record.json>              Repeat for earlier signed records; prepare takes the immediate predecessor first.
  --require-complete-chain                 Reject any superseded run without a predecessor signature.
  --trust-policy <policy.json>             Recipient-selected external signer policy.
  --trust-policy-sha256 <SHA-256>          Independently trusted canonical policy digest; required with policy.
  --minimum-assurance <level>              Verify: unsigned, self_signed, signed, organization_attested or independent; applies to every link.
  --expected-subject-sha256 <SHA-256>      Verify: recipient-selected current bundle digest, to reject an older valid record.

Notes:
  - All committed files must be inside --root. Paths supplied on the CLI resolve from the working directory.
  - No keys are created, no data is uploaded, and no conformance tier is elevated. Historical file bytes and trusted timestamps are not verified.
  - See references/audit-bundle-attestation.md for the signed format, offline trust and archival limits.
```

### 日本語

```text
保存した監査ファイルと前段の署名を、オフラインで準備・照合します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit audit-bundle prepare --root <directory> --run <run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --report <report.md|html> --output <new-private-record.json>
  accessibility-audit audit-bundle verify --root <directory> --record <private-record.json> [trust options]

オプション:
  --report <file>                          準備時に署名対象へ含めるレポート。1〜16件を個別に指定します。
  --attachment <file>                      準備時に含める保存済みソースや取得ファイル。複数指定できます。
  --predecessor <record.json>              過去の署名済み記録。準備時は直前の記録を最初に指定します。
  --require-complete-chain                 前段の署名がないsupersedes履歴を拒否します。
  --trust-policy <policy.json>             受領者が独立に選んだ署名者の信頼方針。
  --trust-policy-sha256 <SHA-256>          別途信頼した方針の正規化SHA-256。方針と対で必須です。
  --minimum-assurance <level>              検証時の最低水準。unsigned、self_signed、signed、organization_attested、independent。全段へ適用します。
  --expected-subject-sha256 <SHA-256>      受領者が別途確認した今回の署名対象ハッシュ。古い有効記録への置換を拒否します。

注意:
  - 署名対象ファイルはすべて--root内に置きます。CLIの相対パスは作業ディレクトリ基準です。
  - 鍵の生成、送信、適合主張の昇格は行いません。過去の実ファイルと信頼できる時刻は未確認です。
  - 形式、外部の信頼方針、保存上の制約はreferences/audit-bundle-attestation.mdを参照してください。
```

## `human-review`

### English

```text
Export/import human review worksheets; prepare, verify or apply portable review records.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit human-review prepare --assessment <assessment.json> --review <declared-review.json> --reviewer-id <id> --output <new-record.json>
  accessibility-audit human-review export --run <run.json> --queue <registered-queue-id> --format xlsx|csv|markdown --output <new-sheet>
  accessibility-audit human-review import --run <run.json> --queue <registered-queue-id> --input <completed-sheet> --output <new-artifact.json> [--artifact-id <id>]
  accessibility-audit human-review prepare --run <run.json> --artifact-id <id> --reviewer-id <id> --output <new-record.json>
  accessibility-audit human-review verify --record <record.json> --assessment <assessment.json> [trust options]
  accessibility-audit human-review apply --record <record.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --output <new-assessment.json> [trust options]

Notes:
  - Trust options: --trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> --trust-policy-sha256 <independent canonical SHA-256> [--minimum-assurance signed].
  - Verify also accepts --run and --artifact-id. Run-backed results are applied by merge --review-record.
  - No signing keys are created. Stored flags, self-signed keys and declarations never authenticate a person. See references/reviewer-assurance.md.
```

## `network-policy`

### English

```text
Propose concrete target and official-source network scopes without granting or using network access.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit network-policy [--target <URL>] [--exact-target <URL>] [--include-official-sources true] [--profile <id>] [--method GET|HEAD] [--allow-localhost true] [--output <new-policy.json>]

Notes:
  - Targets, exact targets and methods are repeatable. Review the proposal before passing its file to init --network-policy.
  - Official sources are exact registered URLs in a separate purpose scope. A policy file never grants caller authority.
```

```text
  accessibility-audit network-policy [--target <URL>] [--exact-target <URL>] [--include-official-sources true] [--profile <id>] [--method GET|HEAD] [--allow-localhost true] [--output <new-policy.json>]

注意:
  - Targets, exact targets and methods are repeatable. Review the proposal before passing its file to init --network-policy.
  - Official sources are exact registered URLs in a separate purpose scope. A policy file never grants caller authority.
```

## `import`

### English

```text
Import native axe-core results as private, run-bound screening candidates.

Notes:
```


## `capture-targets`

### English

```text
Measure file, Git, HTTP or saved web-state identities into a private run companion.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit capture-targets --run <run.json> --specs <target-specs.json> [--after-version <new-version>] [--allow-origin <origin>] [--allow-url <exact-URL>] [--allow-localhost true] [--network-log-output <artifacts/network.json>] --output <artifacts/new-targets.json>

Notes:
  - Target specifications must cover exactly the declared run references. Local relative paths resolve beside the run manifest.
  - HTTP requires a concrete run policy, explicit caller origin/URL authorization and --network-log-output. Every redirect is checked. No credentials, cookies or JavaScript are used.
  - This creates an unregistered private companion. Use bind-targets before registering observations; --after-version instead measures a declared external change. See references/measured-targets.md.
```



### English

```text
Read run state, evidence coverage, validation, successor warnings and next operations.

  --format <text|json>                     Text or versioned JSON output. Default: text.
```

## `init`

### English

```text
Create a new immutable audit run.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit init --run-id <id> --profile <id> --inspection-mode <quick|detailed> --inspection-purpose <purpose> --target-name <name> --target-version <version> --target-ref <url|file> --artifact-root <directory> --network <none|local_read_only> --interaction <safe_read_only|human_supervised> --source-write <none|authorized_only> [--config <scope-environment.json>] --output <new-run.json>

Options:
  --run-id <id>                            Unique run ID.
  --profile <id>                           Active standards profile. Use `profiles list` to discover values.
  --inspection-mode <quick|detailed>       Choose a quick check or a detailed inspection for remediation before inspecting.
  --inspection-purpose <purpose>           Describe how the requester will use the report.
  --target-name <name>                     Human-readable target name.
  --target-version <version>               Declared target version or commit.
  --target-ref <url|file>                  Target URL or file. Repeat for additional target references.
  --artifact-root <directory>              Existing private directory for run artifacts.
  --network <none|local_read_only>         Network policy alias. `none` denies access; `local_read_only` maps to an allowlisted read policy.
  --network-policy <policy.json>           Required for allowlisted/local_read_only: explicit origins or exact URLs, GET/HEAD and redirect/resource policy. Propose with network-policy.
  --interaction <safe_read_only|human_supervised> Interaction policy alias.
  --interaction-policy <policy.json>       Required for human_supervised: concrete operations, supervisor, scope, expiry and approval mode. A saved policy does not authorize runtime interaction.
  --source-write <none|authorized_only>    Source-write policy. Standard audits normally use `none`.
  --config <file>                          Optional JSON file declaring scope and/or environment.
  --supersedes-run <file>                  Validated predecessor required only for retest initialization.
  --output <new-run.json>                  New output path; existing files are never overwritten.

Notes:
  - The artifact root must already exist and must not traverse a symbolic link or reparse point.
  - Inspection mode and purpose are required for new inspections. Retests inherit an existing request; changing it requires a separate inspection.
  - Initialization records scope and permissions but does not inspect the target or create a profile outcome.
```

### 日本語

```text
新しい不変のaudit runを作成します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit init --run-id <id> --profile <id> --inspection-mode <quick|detailed> --inspection-purpose <purpose> --target-name <name> --target-version <version> --target-ref <url|file> --artifact-root <directory> --network <none|local_read_only> --interaction <safe_read_only|human_supervised> --source-write <none|authorized_only> [--config <scope-environment.json>] --output <new-run.json>

オプション:
  --run-id <id>                            一意のrun ID。
  --profile <id>                           activeな規格profile。値は`profiles list`で確認できます。
  --inspection-mode <quick|detailed>       検査前に、簡易チェック（quick）か詳細検査・改善用（detailed）を選びます。
  --inspection-purpose <purpose>           依頼者がレポートを何に使うかを記録します。
  --target-name <name>                     人が読める対象名。
  --target-version <version>               申告する対象版またはcommit。
  --target-ref <url|file>                  対象URLまたはfile。複数指定できます。
  --artifact-root <directory>              run artifactを保存する既存の非公開directory。
  --network <none|local_read_only>         network policy alias。`none`は拒否、`local_read_only`はallowlist付きread policyへ変換します。
  --network-policy <policy.json>           Required for allowlisted/local_read_only: explicit origins or exact URLs, GET/HEAD and redirect/resource policy. Propose with network-policy.
  --interaction <safe_read_only|human_supervised> interaction policy alias。
  --interaction-policy <policy.json>       Required for human_supervised: concrete operations, supervisor, scope, expiry and approval mode. A saved policy does not authorize runtime interaction.
  --source-write <none|authorized_only>    source-write policy。通常の監査では`none`を使います。
  --config <file>                          scopeまたはenvironmentを申告する任意のJSON file。
  --supersedes-run <file>                  retest初期化時だけ必要な検証済みpredecessor。
  --output <new-run.json>                  新規出力path。既存fileは上書きしません。

注意:
  - artifact rootは既に存在し、symbolic linkまたはreparse pointを経由してはいけません。
  - 新規検査ではレベルと利用目的が必須です。再検査は既存の依頼内容を引き継ぎ、変更する場合は別の検査を開始します。
  - 初期化はscopeとpermissionを記録するだけで、対象を検査したりprofile outcomeを作成したりしません。
```

## `scan-web`

### English

```text
Run rule-based browser checks and create a compact AI review context.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit scan-web --url <http-or-https-url> --profile <active-profile> --output <new-scan.json> [--context-output <new-context.json>] [--allow-origin <origin>] [--allow-localhost] [--focus-steps <0-50>] [--width <240-7680>] [--height <240-7680>] [--reflow-width <240-1280>]

Options:
  --url <URL>                              Public HTTP(S) target URL.
  --profile <id>                           Active Web profile.
  --output <file>                          Full internal scan artifact.
  --context-output <file>                  Optional compact AI context.
  --axe-output <file>                      Private native axe results with capture and per-frame execution metadata; requires --evidence-output.
  --evidence-output <file>                 Private saved web bundle for capture-targets; requires --axe-output.
  --browser-channel <chrome>               Use installed system Chrome explicitly instead of the default browser runtime.
  --allow-origin <origin>                  Additional explicit origin; repeatable.
  --allow-url <exact-URL>                  Explicit exact URL including query; repeatable.

  --network-log-output <artifacts/network.json> Private per-request run/policy log. Saved on captured failures too. Cross-origin iframe capture is unverified and blocked.

  --width <240-7680>                       Primary viewport width; default 1280.
  --height <240-7680>                      Primary viewport height; default 800.

  --width 1280
  --height 800
  --reflow-width 320

Notes:
  - Automated findings remain screening evidence and never become profile pass/fail outcomes automatically.
```

```text
Show one registered requirement by exact internal ID (legacy-compatible entry point).

Usage:
  accessibility-audit requirement --profile <id> --id <requirement-id> [--locale ja|en] [--format json|markdown]

Options:
  --profile <id>                           Active profile.
  --id <requirement-id>                    Exact registered internal ID.
  --format <json|markdown>                 Output format; default json.
  --locale <ja|en>                         Human-readable locale.

Notes:
  - For discovery by number or keyword, use `requirements show` or `requirements search`.
```

### 日本語

```text
正確な内部IDで登録済み条項を1件表示します（legacy互換入口）。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit requirement --profile <id> --id <requirement-id> [--locale ja|en] [--format json|markdown]

オプション:
  --profile <id>                           active profile。
  --id <requirement-id>                    登録済みの正確な内部ID。
  --format <json|markdown>                 出力形式。既定値はjson。
  --locale <ja|en>                         表示言語。既定値はen。

注意:
  - 番号やkeywordから探す場合は`requirements show`または`requirements search`を使用します。
```

## `preflight-web`

### English

```text
Measure Web inspection capabilities on an isolated fixture without inspecting a target.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit preflight-web [--browser-channel chrome] [--require <comma-separated-capabilities>] [--format text|json]

Options:
  --browser-channel <chrome>               Use installed system Chrome; otherwise use the Playwright Chromium runtime.
  --require <capabilities>                 Require a comma-separated subset of the six registered capabilities.
  --format <text|json>                     Output format; default text.
  --locale <ja|en>                         Human-readable locale.

Notes:
  - Missing required capabilities exit with code 4. Screen-reader runtime remains externally unconfirmed. Success is not completed target inspection.
```

### 日本語

```text
対象を検査せずに、分離したfixtureでWeb検査の実行能力を測定します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit preflight-web [--browser-channel chrome] [--require <comma-separated-capabilities>] [--format text|json]

オプション:
  --browser-channel <chrome>               Use installed system Chrome; otherwise use the Playwright Chromium runtime.
  --require <capabilities>                 Require a comma-separated subset of the six registered capabilities.
  --format <text|json>                     Output format; default text.
  --locale <ja|en>                         Human-readable locale.

注意:
  - Missing required capabilities exit with code 4. Screen-reader runtime remains externally unconfirmed. Success is not completed target inspection.
```

## `doctor`

### English

```text
Diagnose Node, package, registry, distribution, and optional browser capabilities.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit doctor [--locale ja|en] [--format text|json]

Options:
  --format <text|json>                     Output format; default text.
  --locale <ja|en>                         Human-readable locale.

Notes:
  - The command is read-only. Missing optional browser capability produces WARN rather than a false package failure. Run preflight-web to test the actual browser runtime.
```

### 日本語

```text
Node、package、registry、distribution、任意browser capabilityを診断します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit doctor [--locale ja|en] [--format text|json]

オプション:
  --format <text|json>                     出力形式。既定値はtext。
  --locale <ja|en>                         表示言語。既定値はen。

注意:
  - read-only commandです。任意browser capabilityの欠落はpackage failureではなくWARNとして示します。
```

## `non-web-review`

### English

```text
Create, validate, report, and compare private participation reviews for non-Web targets.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit non-web-review init --kind <document-slide|media-content|event-community|participation-workflow> --id <id> --name <name> --version <version> --scope <scope> --output <new.json>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review validate --input <review.json>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review report --input <review.json> --output <new.md>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review compare --before <old.json> --after <new.json> --output <new.md|json> [--format markdown|json] [--locale ja|en]

Options:
  --locale <ja|en>                         Template questions and report language; default ja.
  --format <markdown|json>                 Comparison output format; default markdown.

Notes:
  - No Web audit run or standards profile is created. Reports and comparisons are private participation records, not conformance claims.
```

### 日本語

```text
Web以外の対象について、非公開の参加レビューを作成・検証・報告・比較します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit non-web-review init --kind <document-slide|media-content|event-community|participation-workflow> --id <id> --name <name> --version <version> --scope <scope> --output <new.json>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review validate --input <review.json>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review report --input <review.json> --output <new.md>
  accessibility-audit non-web-review compare --before <old.json> --after <new.json> --output <new.md|json> [--format markdown|json] [--locale ja|en]

オプション:
  --locale <ja|en>                         Template questions and report language; default ja.
  --format <markdown|json>                 Comparison output format; default markdown.

注意:
  - No Web audit run or standards profile is created. Reports and comparisons are private participation records, not conformance claims.
```

### English

```text
Validate an immutable audit run and write a new validation record.

Options:
  --input <run.json>                       Audit run.
  --output <file>                          New validation record.

```

```text
  --output <file>                          新しいvalidation record。
  --historical-resources <skill-root>      Saved resource files whose hashes match this run; read-only.
```

## `validate-assessment`

### English

```text
Validate an assessment and print its coverage and claim guard result.

  accessibility-audit validate-assessment <assessment.json> [--run <run.json>] [--trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> --trust-policy-sha256 <independent canonical SHA-256>]

Notes:

```

```text
assessmentを検証し、coverageとclaim guard結果を表示します。

注意:
  - Current run-backed review records require --run and its original artifacts. Stored authenticated flags are never accepted.
```

## `register`

### English

```text
Register one validated artifact in a new audit-run version.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit register --run <run.json> --artifact <artifact.json> [--allow-origin <origin>] [--allow-url <exact-URL>] [--allow-localhost true] [--network-log-output <artifacts/network.json>] --output <new-run.json>

Options:
  --run <run.json>                         Current run version.
  --artifact <artifact.json>               Validated artifact within its artifact root.
  --allow-origin <origin>                  Explicit HTTP remeasurement origin; repeatable.
  --allow-url <exact-URL>                  Explicit HTTP remeasurement URL; repeatable.
  --network-log-output <artifacts/network.json> Required for HTTP remeasurement; private run-bound request log.
  --allow-localhost <true>                 Permit loopback only for controlled HTTP fixtures.
  --output <new-run.json>                  New immutable run version.
```

### 日本語

```text
検証済みartifactを新しいaudit-run版へ1件登録します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit register --run <run.json> --artifact <artifact.json> [--allow-origin <origin>] [--allow-url <exact-URL>] [--allow-localhost true] [--network-log-output <artifacts/network.json>] --output <new-run.json>

オプション:
  --run <run.json>                         現在のrun版。
  --artifact <artifact.json>               artifact root内の検証済みartifact。
  --allow-origin <origin>                  Explicit HTTP remeasurement origin; repeatable.
  --allow-url <exact-URL>                  Explicit HTTP remeasurement URL; repeatable.
  --network-log-output <artifacts/network.json> Required for HTTP remeasurement; private run-bound request log.
  --allow-localhost <true>                 Permit loopback only for controlled HTTP fixtures.
  --output <new-run.json>                  新しい不変run版。
```

## `merge`

### English

```text
Merge registered artifacts into a new assessment.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit merge --run <run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --artifact <artifact.json> [--claim-tier <reference_only|screened|evaluated_subset>] --output <new-assessment.json>

Options:
  --run <run.json>                         Validated current run.
  --assessment <assessment.json>           Baseline assessment.
  --artifact <artifact.json>               Registered artifact; repeatable.
  --review-record <record.json>            Portable review record bound to a registered human artifact; repeatable.
  --trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> External recipient policy; requires --trust-policy-sha256.
  --trust-policy-sha256 <canonical SHA-256> Policy pin obtained independently of the audit bundle.
  --claim-tier <reference_only|screened|evaluated_subset> Explicit claim request checked against registered evidence. Default: reference_only. Wording comes from the registry.
  --output <new-assessment.json>           New merged assessment.
```

### 日本語

```text
登録済みartifactを新しいassessmentへ統合します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit merge --run <run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --artifact <artifact.json> [--claim-tier <reference_only|screened|evaluated_subset>] --output <new-assessment.json>

オプション:
  --run <run.json>                         検証済みの現在run。
  --assessment <assessment.json>           baseline assessment。
  --artifact <artifact.json>               登録済みartifact。複数指定できます。
  --review-record <record.json>            Portable review record bound to a registered human artifact; repeatable.
  --trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> External recipient policy; requires --trust-policy-sha256.
  --trust-policy-sha256 <canonical SHA-256> Policy pin obtained independently of the audit bundle.
  --claim-tier <reference_only|screened|evaluated_subset> 登録済み証拠で検証する主張範囲。既定値: reference_only。文言はregistryの固定テンプレートです。
  --output <new-assessment.json>           新しいmerged assessment。
```

## `report`

### English

```text
Render a profile-aware, provenance-explicit Markdown report from a validated standalone or run-backed assessment.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit report --input <assessment.json> [report options]
  accessibility-audit report --run <audit-run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --output <new-report.md|html> [--historical-resources <saved-skill-root>] [report options]

Options:
  --input <assessment.json>                Standalone interface.
  --run <audit-run.json>                   Run-backed interface; requires --assessment and --output.
  --assessment <assessment.json>           Merged run-backed assessment.
  --historical-resources <skill-root>      Use saved resources matching the run hashes for a read-only historical report.
  --lifecycle <latest-lifecycle.json>      Add a validated private lifecycle status summary for a registered finding; repeatable.
  --as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>                     Date for overdue and exception-expiry checks; default is the host local date.
  --trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> Reverify reviewer signatures under an external policy; requires its independent pin.
  --trust-policy-sha256 <canonical SHA-256> Independent policy pin. Omitting both trust flags leaves valid signatures self-signed.
  --locale <ja|en>                         Human-readable report locale; default ja. IDs and enum values do not change.
  --output <report.md>                     New report path. Standalone mode may write to stdout when omitted.
  --format <markdown|html>                 Output format. Default: markdown.
  --detail <summary|full>                  Summary or complete 55/56-row report. Default: full.
  --appendix <file>                        With summary, write the complete report in the selected format.
  --visibility <internal|public>           Publication boundary. Default: internal.
  --reviewer-disclosure <include|redact>   Required for public output.
  --redaction-manifest <manifest.json>     Required internal record for public output.

Notes:
  - Use either --input or --run/--assessment, never both.
  - Screening projections are report-only judgements and are never promoted to human-verified profile outcomes.
  - Existing files are never overwritten.
```

### 日本語

```text
検証済みstandaloneまたはrun-backed assessmentから、profile対応・provenance明示のレポートを生成します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit report --input <assessment.json> [report options]
  accessibility-audit report --run <audit-run.json> --assessment <assessment.json> --output <new-report.md|html> [--historical-resources <saved-skill-root>] [report options]

オプション:
  --input <assessment.json>                standalone interface。
  --run <audit-run.json>                   run-backed interface。--assessmentと--outputが必要です。
  --assessment <assessment.json>           統合済みrun-backed assessment。
  --historical-resources <skill-root>      Use saved resources matching the run hashes for a read-only historical report.
  --lifecycle <latest-lifecycle.json>      Add a validated private lifecycle status summary for a registered finding; repeatable.
  --as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>                     Date for overdue and exception-expiry checks; default is the host local date.
  --trust-policy <recipient-selected.json> Reverify reviewer signatures under an external policy; requires its independent pin.
  --trust-policy-sha256 <canonical SHA-256> Independent policy pin. Omitting both trust flags leaves valid signatures self-signed.
  --locale <ja|en>                         人向けレポートの言語。既定値はja。IDとenum値は変わりません。
  --output <report.md>                     新規レポートpath。standaloneでは省略時にstdoutへ出力できます。
  --format <markdown|html>                 出力形式。markdownまたはhtml。既定値はmarkdown。
  --detail <summary|full>                  summaryまたは全55／56行を含むfull。既定値はfull。
  --appendix <file>                        summaryと同じ形式で完全版付録を書き出します。
  --visibility <internal|public>           internalまたはpublic。既定値はinternal。
  --reviewer-disclosure <include|redact>   public出力時のreviewer表示方針。
  --redaction-manifest <manifest.json>     public出力時に必要な内部用伏字記録。

注意:
  - --inputと--run/--assessmentは同時に使用できません。
  - screening projectionはreport-only judgementであり、人手確認済みprofile outcomeへ昇格しません。
  - 既存fileは上書きしません。
  - 自動伏字は公開承認ではありません。公開前の人による確認が必要です。
```

## `retest`

### English

```text
Create a fresh audit run from a registered authorized or externally declared change.

Usage:
  accessibility-audit retest --supersedes-run <old-run.json> [all init options for the new target version]

Notes:
  - Prior evidence and outcomes are not silently inherited.
```

### 日本語

```text
認可済み変更が完了したpredecessorから新しいaudit runを作成します。

使用方法:
  accessibility-audit retest --supersedes-run <old-run.json> [all init options for the new target version]

注意:
  - 以前の証拠とoutcomeを黙って継承しません。
```
